groups.note: E1〜E3 は「知らない人に『お前は誰だ』と聞くように神も聞き、『私は青年です』という答えを一番喜ぶ」を「神は人に興味を持ち、特に若者を深く知ることを喜ぶ」と言い換えている
diff: The Korean original says God asks us “Who are you?” just as we ask a stranger, and is most pleased with the answer “I am a young person” (English edition: “God has the same curiosity about each human being. He is especially curious about young people, and it brings Him great joy when He gets to know them intimately”).

groups.note: 韓国語の「去年」を E34 は「2008年」とする
diff: The Korean original says “last year” (English edition: “In 2008”).

groups.note: E55（目的が無ければ勉強に幸せに要る情熱が欠ける）は英語だけ
groups.en_only_ko: 인생의 뜻이 없으면 공부에는 행복에 필요한 열정이 빠지게 됩니다.

groups.note: E56 の「韓国の」学生は英語だけ
食い違い: 韓国語は「職業はまったく自分の素質と趣味で決めるべきだ」、E68 は「素質と興味だけで決めるべきではない」と逆のことを言う。E69 は例の「政治家」を省いている。E73（人生の目的は何か）は英語だけ
diff: The Korean original says your occupation should be decided entirely by your own aptitude and interests (English edition: “should not be based on just your talents and interests”).
The Korean original's examples also include “a politician” (not in the English edition).
